contexts.text: These (men) are the stocks or roots of these nations.
Collateral good of a common stock. Signified.
That it might be conjoined with the Divine from a direct Divine stock. Treated of.
The origin of interior truth from a Divine stock. Representation.
Shechem = truth from an ancient Divine stock.
The second conjunction with the affection of truth from a Divine stock. Signified.
Conjunction with the affection of truth from a different stock. Signified, Explained.
Of the gentiles some are interior and some exterior, which they derive partly from... the stock from which [they originate].
That David might represent the Lord as to Divine truth, the Lord willed to be born from the house of David, and to be called... his Stock and Offspring.

The stump of the roots which should be left in the earth () = the Word, only the letter of which is understood, and which is merely something known, seated in the memory and thence going forth in speech. ( = the Word, through which the Church should revive... SConf 37.)
